purpose: Illustrative schema for source-linked clinical knowledge and client-specific longitudinal context in STAAD.

node_types.description: Source-linked concept or support principle; not a client diagnosis.
Goal stated by or agreed with the client, in their preferred language.
Preferred communication format, pacing, or support approach.
Dated, observable event or change; distinguish observation from interpretation.
Reported physical or mental health concern requiring human review.
Human-approved support strategy with owner, context, review date, and status.
Session metadata and references to approved session records.

privacy_rules: All client-specific nodes and edges must be tenant/client scoped.
Use least-privilege access and auditable reads/writes.
Do not place direct identifiers in embeddings or graph labels unless strictly necessary and approved.
Synthetic examples in this package are not real client records.
Do not infer diagnosis, consent, capacity, abuse, or risk level from graph links alone.
design_notes: Knowledge Memory stores reusable evidence and guidance.
Client/Graph Memory stores client-specific facts, goals, preferences, and dated observations.
Session Memory stores current-session events and transcript references.
Specialized retrievers are retrieval mechanisms, not separate memory stores.
Context Manager selects source-linked, minimum-necessary context and preserves uncertainty.
